name: the fold below the atom
plain: The gauge vacuum and the hadron: what is below the atom. Measured on a model in one space and one time dimension only.

carrier.state: colour-singlet closure on Gauss's law; the vacuum's conserved charges (TIERS.md, carried)

source.quote: M_V/g = 0.553116, against the staked continuum target 1/√π = 0.564190
The extensive density is the finding.
The rate is the gap to **0.6 %**

remainder: the magic density `c(x)·N`, extensive at every coupling; a ten-site box's price `2^{M₂} ≤ 16` (TIERS.md; GF1_RESULTS.md calls the extensive density a re-finding of Phys. Rev. B 111, L081102)
regime: one space and one time dimension (the Schwinger model); nothing in 3+1 dimensions
not_claimed: Nothing in three space dimensions. TIERS.md: 'MEASURED on 1+1D only', and 'GF2 GATED'.
No certificate is checked here: this is the row as the record words it.
